name: handsum
description: Browser-based multiplayer card game prototype for 2 to 8 players, played peer-to-peer via a shared link.
author: Friedinger

scripts.test:server: podman run --rm -v "$PWD:/app:Z" -w /app php:8.4-cli php -d display_errors=On -d error_reporting=E_ALL server/tests/run.php
scripts.dev:server: podman run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -v "$PWD:/app:Z" -w /app/server php:8.4-cli php -d display_errors=On -d error_reporting=E_ALL -S 0.0.0.0:8080 index.php
